newsitem.title: USA: Orange County,Calif.,extends tender offer deadline.
newsitem.headline: Orange County,Calif.,extends tender offer deadline.

text.p: Orange County, Calif., has extended through Friday the deadline for holders of the county's 1994 Series A pension obligation bonds to agree to tender their bonds, sources close to the financing said.
The deadline was extended to Friday to give bondholders more time to respond to the offer, the sources said. The original deadline was Monday.
Last month, the county Board of Supervisors adopted a resolution authorizing the tender offer of the county's taxable refunding pension obligation bonds.
The proposal calls for the county to sell up to $200 million of debt to refund the outstanding bonds.
